description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 15.06.2015 to 21.06.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and specifically deals with setting new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It rescinds a previous notification and establishes a new regulatory framework for currency conversion rates applicable to customs transactions. This content falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements for customs operations.
